notes.time: About 200 hours to the Platinum, difficulty 4 out of 10 (PowerPyx). One playthrough is enough.
notes.online: No online trophies. The whole list is offline single-player.
notes.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving (PowerPyx). Keep cheats off your trophy save.
notes.replay: There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
notes.missable: Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude (the Chapter 1 balcony meditation).

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1–4 and the finale
roadmap.text: Play the story straight through. The chapter and mission trophies pop as you go, and the finale's gold pops at the end. Two things matter here: do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (Positive Mental Attitude may be missable), and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay.

roadmap.title: Strangers & side stories
roadmap.text: Work the side-character strands to their finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and Bret's hunt. Start every stranger strand the moment it unlocks, and do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 the moment it appears. Finish 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.

roadmap.title: Activities & challenges
roadmap.text: Now the open-world grind: 250 stunts, gold at all 42 shooting-range challenges, a drone race won at all 14 Top Fun spots, 20 different races won, Cal beaten at fishing, one arcade game finished, every activity type tried once, and 50 challenges done.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & the world
roadmap.text: Sweep Leonida: 18 meditation spots, 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK at 100 spots, 100 vehicles found, all 52 areas explored, all 8 garages bought, 10 vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app, $250,000 laundered and $100,000 spent in shops.

roadmap.title: Crime, one-offs & cleanup
roadmap.text: Robberies and stunts (vaults, trucks, the jewelry store, one illegal operation per gang, Combat Focus, the VCIA departure, the Rhino tank), the vague story one-offs, then the 100% checklist for A Long Road — and the Platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no shortcut: the long pole is A Long Road (100% completion). Work the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, crime — and keep cheats off the whole run, since PowerPyx reports cheats disable trophies and saving.
steps: Finish the story and every stage of the roadmap below
Earn A Long Road (100% completion) — the last big gate
Keep cheats off your trophy save from start to finish

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and finish it — the trophy pops at the end of the mission. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
steps: Start Chapter 1 and play Gone Fishing to the end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 — just play the story through and it pops when the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy): it is the one thing in Chapter 1 that may not come back.
steps: Play Chapter 1 through to its end
Do Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter closes (see Positive Mental Attitude)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story trophy — finish the chapter. By now both protagonists are playable, so most of the open-world list opens up: use the free roam between missions to start activities and collectibles.
steps: Play Chapter 2 through to its end

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story trophy. Watch for the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Yago's street-racing strand (marked with an hourglass) — it counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so do it the moment it appears.
steps: Play Chapter 3 through to its end
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears (time-sensitive)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story trophy — finish the chapter and the finale is in reach. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.
steps: Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4
Play Chapter 4 through to its end

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Story trophy, gold. Keep a manual save before the final mission — with no mission replay, that save is the only way to redo the ending. After the credits, everything outside the story stays available.
steps: Keep a manual save before the final mission
Finish the final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story trophy — it pops when the mission ends. Mission trophies cannot be missed as long as you finish the mission, and there is no gold-medal requirement on any mission.
steps: Play the mission Breakfast Run to the end

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Story trophy. Heist missions are story-gated, so just play through the story; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
steps: Play the mission The Cartel Heist to the end

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story trophy — finish the mission and it pops.
steps: Play the mission Child's Play to the end

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story trophy — finish the mission and it pops.
steps: Play the mission Headliners to the end

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophy. The mission takes you into VCIA airport — the same airport matters for Catch Me If You Can (the unscheduled departure), so keep the airport in mind while you are there.
steps: Play the mission VCIA Takedown to the end

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy — finish the mission and it pops.
steps: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to the end

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The hardest trophy in the set (PowerPyx). The checklist is 35 tasks and its thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges. Finish the story first, then work the checklist after the credits; most of it comes from doing the other trophies.
steps: Finish the story
Work the 35-task checklist after the credits — vehicles, animals, stunts, challenges
Watch the in-game completion percentage: that is what counts

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in total across 4 kinds: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps (PowerPyx). Any 250 count; the 100% checklist wants 300. Stunt Jumps are the easiest to grind — find a ramp, jump, repeat. The game tracks your total, so chip away between missions.
steps: Do Stunt Jumps early — the most numerous and the easiest
Fly under bridges for the 202 Under the Bridges set
Reach 250 for the trophy; 300 for the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types in the game. Just sample one of each — a race, a drone race, fishing, an arcade game, the shooting range, and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish them.
steps: Open the activities list and try one of each type
The trophy pops after the last new type

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. All 42 must be gold — silver is not enough. Learn each range's layout, use the right weapon for the drill, and replay the ones you miss; ranges can be retried as often as you like.
steps: Unlock the shooting ranges and run every challenge
Replay any challenge until it is gold — 42 golds are required

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. 14 locations. Win one race at each — learn the gates on each course, cut corners where the track allows, and retry a location until the win registers.
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location
Win at all 14

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. 20 distinct races — repeats of the same race do not count twice. Mix race types (street, off-road, air, water) and work through the race list; winning is what counts, not just entering.
steps: Win 20 different races across the race types

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him: land the bigger catch within the challenge's rules. Fishing challenges can be retried, so keep at it until you win.
steps: Meet Cal and start his fishing challenge
Out-fish him to win the challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade machine, play one game through to its end. Any game counts — choose the shortest one.
steps: Find an arcade machine and finish one game

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side-story finale — work Andy's mission strand to its last mission and finish it. Side strands stay available after the story, but start them when they unlock so nothing is left waiting.
steps: Start Andy's strand when it unlocks
Play it through to its final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Side-story finale — work Kenton's strand to its last mission and finish it.
steps: Start Kenton's strand when it unlocks
Play it through to its final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Side-story finale — work Billy's strand to its last mission and finish it.
steps: Start Billy's strand when it unlocks
Play it through to its final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. 8 full stranger strands. Start each strand the moment it unlocks — one race in Chapter 3 (Race Against Yago) is time-sensitive, marked with an hourglass, so do it immediately when it appears. Strands stay open after the story, but the timed one does not wait.
steps: Pick up every stranger strand as it unlocks
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3
Finish 8 strands end to end

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Side-story finale — work Randy's strand to its last mission and finish it.
steps: Start Randy's strand when it unlocks
Play it through to its final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Side-story finale — work Tyrone's strand to its last mission and finish it.
steps: Start Tyrone's strand when it unlocks
Play it through to its final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. 18 meditation spots. THE missable one: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it as the only possibly missable trophy, because it disappears after Chapter 1. Do it the morning after the mission Down to Earth, when Lucia heads to the balcony. Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops. The other 17 spots are spread across Leonida and stay available.
steps: Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony in the morning and meditate
Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until this trophy pops
Meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's stranger strand leads to a hunt for one specific unique animal. Follow Bret's missions until the hunt unlocks, track the animal, and take it down.
steps: Work Bret's strand until the hunt opens
Track and hunt the unique animal

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find cards across Leonida and finish 3 full sets. Cards are a collectible like the others — sweep areas as you explore and complete sets one at a time.
steps: Collect cards while exploring
Complete 3 full sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different spots across Leonida. It is a count trophy — just keep tagging new locations as you travel; the game tracks how many distinct spots you have done.
steps: WAiNK It at new locations while travelling
Reach 100 distinct locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. 50 of the 80 challenges. Challenges overlap with everything else you do — stunts, races, exploration — so most of them complete themselves; check the challenge list and mop up the easy ones. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80.
steps: Play normally — challenges complete as you do other trophies
Check the list and finish the easiest remaining ones to reach 50

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and get clean away. Use fast cars, break line of sight, and hide until the wanted level clears — it pops when you escape.
steps: With your partner alongside, raise a 4-star wanted level
Break line of sight and escape until the heat is gone

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not let it clear between robberies. Pick shops close together, move fast, and keep the heat on.
steps: With your partner, rob a shop, then two more in a row
Keep your wanted level active between all three

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Find and get into 100 different vehicles. Every new model you sit in counts; the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this trophy is a step on the way there.
steps: Drive every new vehicle you find
Reach 100 distinct vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy firefight, aim for grouped enemies, and use a weapon that kills fast.
steps: Find a fight with 5+ enemies close together
Trigger Combat Focus and down all five in one use

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the airport did not schedule — steal a plane and take off without following the usual departure. The airport is the place; the trick is the exit.
steps: Go to VCIA and get to a plane
Take off in an unscheduled departure

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank — steal one from a military base or provoke one into the open — and the trophy pops once you are driving it. A video guide shows stealing a tank triggering it with a 3-star wanted level. Expect heavy police attention the moment you take it.
steps: Find a Rhino tank (military base or high wanted level)
Steal it and drive — the trophy pops on the takeover

sources.name: YouTube — GTA 6: How to Get Military Tank

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, and get out without any alarm or witness spotting you. Plan the approach — mask up, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry
Rob it and leave with no one detecting you

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Vaults are the big robberies — plan the getaway before you go in, and escape the wanted level after each one.
steps: Rob a bank vault, then escape the heat
Repeat for 5 vaults

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash, and escape the wanted level. Trucks run routes — watch traffic, hit one, and be gone before the cops close in.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Rob it and escape

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the state. Just travel everywhere — the map fills in as you go, and the trophy pops when the last area is discovered. Use flights, boats and drives to reach the far corners.
steps: Travel to every corner of the map
Reach all 52 areas

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. 9 gangs, one illegal operation each. Find each gang's operation, rob it, and move on to the next gang — the trophy pops when all 9 are done.
steps: Locate one illegal operation per gang
Rob all 9

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Have a cocktail at a bar with a view over Ocean Beach. PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known at launch — it points to a story or world moment, so play through the story and check the Ocean Beach bars when you are in Vice City.
steps: Go to a bar overlooking Ocean Beach
Order the cocktail with the view

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's frontage and out the other side, in the classic smash-and-grab style. PowerPyx lists the trigger as not yet known at launch — try a showroom in Vice City and drive straight through it.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom
Smash out through the front in a car

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and play a game through. The follow-through is the point — finish the game you start.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Play a full game of bowling

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A story-moment trophy with a deliberately vague description — PowerPyx lists it as not yet known, and other launch guides agree it points to a story beat with your partner. Play the story; it pops at its moment.
steps: Play through the story with your partner
It pops at its story moment

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Tied to the Criminal Profile (PowerPyx): the choices you make shape your profile. Note the warning — the 'Irredeemable' profile is permanent, and cops get more aggressive with it, so avoid a full rampage on your trophy save.
steps: Make story and world choices as you play
Avoid the permanent 'Irredeemable' profile — keep your record clean-ish

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. A story-moment trophy: something that fails the first time and works the second. PowerPyx lists the trigger as not yet known at launch — play the story and it pops at its moment.
steps: Play the story; it pops at its moment

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A story-moment trophy with a deliberately strange description — a weird event in the story. PowerPyx lists it as not yet known at launch; play through and it will find you.
steps: Play the story; it pops at its strange moment

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. PowerPyx lists the method as not yet known at launch — a drive-by with a melee weapon is the plain reading of the description: get in a car, pull alongside a pedestrian, and swing.
steps: Get in a vehicle with a melee weapon
Knock someone down with a melee drive-by

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Marked bills come from robberies — keep laundering as you earn them and the total climbs.
steps: Collect marked bills from robberies
Launder them through your contacts to $250,000

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total across shops — clothes, food, gear, anything. It adds up over a normal playthrough; if you are close at the end, buy big-ticket items to finish it.
steps: Spend across shops as you play
Reach $100,000 total

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. They cost money, so this one follows your earning — buy them as you can afford them.
steps: Buy each garage property when you can afford it
Own all 8

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register 10 vehicles you own or find to the Scooter Bros app. Any 10 count — register the ones you drive most.
steps: Register vehicles to the Scooter Bros app
Reach 10 registrations
